questions.prompt: In "A Letter to God", why does Lencho call the post-office employees "a bunch of crooks"?

expected_answer.value: He received only seventy pesos instead of the hundred he had asked for

options: He received only seventy pesos instead of the hundred he had asked for
He never received any reply to his letter
The letter was returned because it had no stamp
He was asked to pay a fee to collect the money
questions.explanation: Lencho asked God for one hundred pesos but the postmaster could gather only seventy. Lencho trusted God completely, so he assumed the employees had kept the rest.

questions.prompt: According to Nelson Mandela in "Long Walk to Freedom", courage is:

expected_answer.value: not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it

options: not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it
the ability to defeat any opponent
questions.explanation: Mandela says the brave man is not he who does not feel afraid, but he who conquers that fear.

questions.prompt: Which system of racial discrimination was ended in South Africa when Mandela became president in 1994?
questions.explanation: Apartheid was South Africa's system of legalised racial discrimination. Mandela became the first democratically elected president of the country in 1994.

questions.prompt: By what name does Anne Frank address her diary?
questions.explanation: Anne calls her diary "Kitty" and writes to it as if to a close friend.

questions.prompt: Which incident on the return journey saddens Valli in "Madam Rides the Bus"?

expected_answer.value: Seeing a dead cow by the roadside

options: Seeing a dead cow by the roadside
questions.explanation: Valli's first sight of death, a dead cow, moves her and shows she has gained a more mature view of the world.

questions.prompt: In "Dust of Snow", what shook down the dust of snow on the speaker?

expected_answer.value: A crow sitting in a hemlock tree

options: A crow sitting in a hemlock tree
questions.explanation: The crow shook snow from a hemlock tree, and this small moment changed the speaker's mood and saved part of his day.

questions.prompt: In Robert Frost's "Fire and Ice", what does fire symbolise?
questions.explanation: Frost links fire with desire and ice with hatred, suggesting both could destroy the world.

questions.prompt: "The wind whispered through the trees." Which device is used in this line?
questions.explanation: Giving the human action of whispering to the wind is personification.

questions.prompt: Why did Tricki, the Pekinese, become ill in "A Triumph of Surgery"?

expected_answer.value: Mrs Pumphrey overfed and over-pampered him

options: He was bitten by another dog
He was kept without any food
Mrs Pumphrey overfed and over-pampered him
questions.explanation: Mrs Pumphrey gave Tricki too many rich treats. Mr Herriot cured him by putting him on a strict diet at the surgery.

questions.prompt: In "The Thief's Story", what does Anil offer to teach Hari Singh?
questions.explanation: Anil, a young writer, trusts the thief and offers to teach him to read and write.

questions.prompt: Who is the secret agent in "The Midnight Visitor"?
questions.explanation: Ausable is the secret agent. Fowler is the young aspiring writer who first meets him, and Max is the rival agent.

questions.prompt: What hobby did the young Richard Ebright begin that led him towards science?
questions.explanation: Ebright started by collecting butterflies, which grew into serious scientific work.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: By the time we reached the station, the train ___.
questions.explanation: The past perfect shows an action completed before another past event, here the arrival at the station.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct modal: You ___ park here. It is strictly prohibited.
questions.explanation: "Must not" expresses prohibition, while "need not" means something is unnecessary.

questions.prompt: Which is the passive form of "The teacher praised the student"?

expected_answer.value: The student was praised by the teacher.

options: The student is praised by the teacher.
The student was praised by the teacher.
The student had praised the teacher.
The teacher was praised by the student.
questions.explanation: The simple past active becomes "was/were + past participle" in the passive, with the object becoming the subject.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct reported form: She said, "I am tired."

expected_answer.value: She said that she was tired.

options: She said that she is tired.
She said that I was tired.
She said that she was tired.
She said that she had been tired.
questions.explanation: With a past reporting verb, the present tense "am" backshifts to "was" and the pronoun "I" changes to "she".

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: Neither of the two answers ___ correct.
questions.explanation: "Neither" takes a singular verb when it is followed by "of the two answers".

questions.prompt: In "I know that he is honest", the underlined clause "that he is honest" is a:
questions.explanation: The clause acts as the object of the verb "know", so it works as a noun clause.

questions.prompt: A formal letter that begins with "Dear Sir" should end with:
questions.explanation: When the salutation is "Dear Sir/Madam", the correct complimentary close is "Yours faithfully".

questions.prompt: An analytical paragraph based on a chart should mainly:

expected_answer.value: describe trends and compare the data given, without personal opinion

options: tell a story about the people in the chart
list only the title and source of the chart
describe trends and compare the data given, without personal opinion
argue for the writer's own point of view
questions.explanation: An analytical paragraph reports and compares what the data shows, such as highs, lows and trends.

questions.prompt: Rina closed her umbrella, shook off the water and hung her dripping coat by the door. What can be inferred?
options: It was a very sunny day.
questions.explanation: The umbrella and the dripping coat are clues that it was raining.
